sections.heading: Conditions — a record proves the candidate only when ALL of these hold on it:

rules.text: What the record evidences is itself one {{entity_noun}}, judged against what the candidate means; a thing the record names as something else is that thing, not one.

children.text: Does the record place the company in a market, or only name what it makes or does? A company places itself in a market by saying whom it serves, by naming a product by who uses it, by the heading it puts over a list, or by what it publishes about itself for that market's buyers, when the step from the publication to the market is one a reader of the trade takes without more. A record that only names what the company makes, does, or has places it in no market, and the candidate fails here. A market is named by the group of organizations it gathers, never by the thing they buy: a product's name is not a market's name.

rules.text: The record names the candidate — or something the candidate is a broader kind of — in its own words or one plain step from them. A candidate the record does not name is not proven, however likely it is: naming a thing does not name what made it, what it is made with, or what it is made of.

The manufacturer is the party whose business the dealing is — under whatever name it trades or is organized, at whatever site, under whatever arrangement it controls or directs. A party that does the same thing as its own business is not the manufacturer, however it relates to it. Read the dealing from the manufacturer's side: the manufacturer's name in the sentence does not settle it, and a dealing the record states from another party's side is that party's unless the record makes it the manufacturer's.

children.text: The manufacturer is named at the top of the request; a record may refer to it by that name, as the manufacturer, or by a name it trades under.
Supplying or selling into a market is serving it: where the manufacturer supplies a party that operates in the candidate market, the manufacturer serves that market.

The dealing must be the one named above — {{entity_relationships.gerund}} the candidate. A different dealing with the same thing, such as selling what another party makes or using what another party sells, is not it, whoever the manufacturer is.

sections.heading: Guards — any one of these rules the record out:

rules.text: The involvement is not current and actual.
The candidate names no particular member of the kind — a term that fixes nothing — so no record proves it.
